answer_1.quote: We validate our ADLM on two detoxification experiments: the language generation task on RealToxicityPrompts and dialogue generation task on ToxiChat and DiaSafety. ... We also validate ADLM on a sentiment-controlled text generation task.
answer_1.outputs: detoxified text continuations and safe dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: To automatically measure the toxicity of the generated texts, we utilize Perspective API. To measure diversity, we calculate the mean of distance n-grams normalized by total text length. We also report perplexity (PPL) as a fluency metric.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation of generated texts using our method, by comparing it to ones generated by the best-performing baselines, DExperts and GeDi ... We recruited a total of 45 participants on Mechanical Turk ... The participants rated the generated continuations on toxicity, grammatical correctness, topic coherency, and overall fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Participants scored each continuation from 1 to 5 on toxicity, grammatical correctness, topic coherency, and overall fluency.
